purpose: Untuned prompts reserved for the next reader review. These questions have not been run against search and supply no current quality score.
method: Let readers write their own queries first. Record their exact wording and selected destination. A facilitator then judges the answer against the source passage, independently of ranking. Keep this set out of aliases and vocabulary.
prompts: Find how you would check who is allowed to approve a proposed change.
Find how a later worker should handle evidence whose selection is out of date.
Find what you would need before connecting two kinds of records in a new way.
Find how to tell whether an experiment produced a result or established a broader claim.
Find how to determine whether a saved lesson helped a later attempt.
Find the difference between checking room for a reservation and creating the reservation.
Find what a reader should compare before accepting a revised definition.
Find which software and examples this edition provides for local use.
